description_zh: 阿斯卡尔·阿卡耶夫（1944 年出生）是吉尔吉斯斯坦总统（1990-2005 年）。拥有物理学背景的总统，通过和平方式领导国家向民主转型。2005 年郁金香革命导致他流亡到莫斯科。他的物理思维方式影响了中亚政治发展。
description_en: Askar Akayev (born 1944) was President of Kyrgyzstan (1990-2005). Physicist-turned-president peacefully led country towards democracy. Tulip Revolution in 2005 led to his exile in Moscow. His physics mindset influenced Central Asian political development.
reason_zh: 阿卡耶夫的治理智慧体现在物理思维和民主转型中。通过物理思维方式领导国家向民主转型。郁金香革命体现了吉尔吉斯斯坦的民主觉醒。他的流亡体现了中亚政治转型的复杂性。
reason_en: Akayev's governance wisdom exemplified in physics mindset and democratic transition. Led country towards democracy through physics approach. Tulip Revolution embodied Kyrgyz democratic awakening. His exile demonstrated Central Asian political transformation complexity.
